_comment: Single curated source of truth for the landing (index.html) AND every product dashboard (scripts/build-dashboards.js). Add a prototype by adding an item here; it appears on the next push. Give every item a desc (~150 chars). Wrap related items in { folder, items } to render them as a real dashboard folder (sidebar entry with status pills, selectable scope, favoritable). Statuses: ready-for-dev | in-progress (default) | archived.
